title: Reenchanted
description: Re-balances enchantments and adds new fun and useful enchantments.
body:
Reenchanted is a datapack focused on rebalancing and improoving minecraft enchanting.
It changes multiple vanilla enchantments, tweaks the balance of enchanting and ads new enchantments. 
Among the new enchantments are inclooded enchatments from other games in the minecraft universe, mainly MC Dungeons, and some unique new enchants.

Rebalanced and reworked vanilla enchantments:
-Mending:Now incompatible with unbreaking and secoundary enchantments such as fortune, flame, fire aspect and depth strider,
-Sharpnes, Smite, Impaling, Fire Aspect, Knockback and Looting:Can now be applied to all weapons,
-Power, Infinity, Flame:Can now be put on crossbows,
-Quick Charge: Max level is now 5, but it is not compatible with power,
-Depth Strider: Is now excusive to pants instead of boots.

To craft the enchanting table you now need to find a enchanted book, making enchanting a more rewarding thing to unluck and encouraging exploration and adventure.
